subject: astronomy
title: Planets & Moons: Tour the Inner Worlds
welcome_lead: Four rocky planets and a few small moons — let's meet them.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars.
final_note: Rocky worlds are different but share a lot in common.

concepts.def: Smallest, closest planet to the Sun.
The red planet, has water ice.

walkthroughs.body_html: Mercury is small, cratered and has wild temperature swings. Venus is hotter than Mercury thanks to a thick CO2 atmosphere that traps heat.
Earth has liquid water, a magnetic field and a mix of land and ocean. So far the only planet known to host life.
Mars has the tallest volcano (Olympus Mons), polar ice caps and two small moons, Phobos and Deimos.
